description.value: The Gibsons Garden Hotel is the largest hotel in Gibsons, situated in the heart of Upper Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast roughly seven minutes from the Langdale Ferry Terminal. Its 54 rooms range from standard queens to kitchenette suites with cooktops, making it practical for multi-night or extended stays. An indoor heated pool, outdoor hot tub, dry sauna, and fitness centre round out a solid suite of recovery amenities for tired cyclists.

address.value: 963 Gibsons Way, Gibsons, British Columbia V0N 1V8
